The '''Odacer-Faustin Sith temple''' was a [[Sith temple/Legends|Sith temple]] constructed by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Drear]] beneath the [[Odacer-Faustin Sith academy|Sith academy]] on [[Odacer-Faustin]]. Approximately a thousand [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following Drear's [[Death/Legends|death]], the temple was used by [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Scabrous]].
